correctness.rationale: The bipartite mixed/pure partition gives adjacency block matrix [0,T;T^T,0]. The even-degree image of the two complete-graph incidence matrices and the sole simultaneous-even constant-gauge ambiguity give rank(T)=m+n-2-δ. The pure kernel is the disjoint union of even-even and (when permitted) odd-odd edge-degree classes; discrete character projection proves E and O. Orthogonality over im(T) and its exact 2^δ parametrization multiplicity proves X. Independent Gaussian elimination and complete finite kernel enumeration agree with every coefficient on six graph sizes; the proof, not the enumeration, covers all m,n≥2.
